plan_a_advantages: Includes hill repeats and a tempo run, directly addressing speed development.
Features a longer long run (22km) which is more representative of trail race distances.

reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates a more targeted approach to improving speed, including hill repeats and a dedicated tempo run, which are crucial for trail running performance. Plan B, while emphasizing aerobic base building, lacks the specific intensity work needed to translate that base into faster times. Plan A’s inclusion of varied workouts and a longer long run also better simulates the demands of trail races, while Plan B’s focus on consistent easy runs could lead to a plateau in speed development.
